description.value: Ciclo Espresso The Post is a modern Italian coffee bar situated inside The Post development in downtown Vancouver, serving specialty espresso drinks, 72-hour fermented dough panino baked in an open-flame brick forno, house pastries, Neve gelato from Milan, and cocktails. It is one of three Ciclo locations across Vancouver, each with a distinct character and menu. Touring cyclists will find a quality urban refueling stop with outdoor seating and an Italian-inspired menu that goes well beyond standard cafe fare.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Ciclo Espresso The Post is an active Italian coffee bar at a Vancouver location called 'The Post', open Monday to Friday, with an active multi-location website. The phone number 604.428.6111 on the website contact page matches OSM's +1-604-428-6111. However, the contact page lists '891 Homer Street' while OSM records '695 Homer Street' — flagged as a concern since the Post-specific subpage gives no street number and the contact page may represent a different Ciclo location. No explicit bike parking, washroom, or water refill evidence appears on the website or in OSM tags; vegetarian options are supported by OSM diet:vegetarian=yes and confirmed by the Margherita panino and pastry/gelato items on the website menu.
concerns: Address mismatch: OSM records 695 Homer Street, but the website contact page shows 891 Homer Street — the Post-specific subpage gives no street number, so the contact page may refer to a different Ciclo location; OSM address retained pending verification.
Contact page email (info@persesocialcorner.com) does not match the Ciclo Espresso brand name, suggesting a parent or management company operating under a separate entity.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, actively operating Italian coffee bar in downtown Vancouver with a current website, recent OSM check-date (2026-03-26), and multiple confirmed locations; a clear and useful stop for touring cyclists.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Website menu includes Margherita panino (san marzano, stracciatella, fior di latte, basil, arugula — no meat) and pastries/gelato with no meat content

wow_evidence: one of three Ciclo locations across Vancouver
